context.transcript:
Hi, I'm Alexey Solikov.
I own a small business and I'm interested in ordering some shirts from your company.
See, all of my employees are going to a trade show next month and I want them to wear shirts embroidered with our logo.
I looked at your design options and I prefer the design with the logo on the sleeve of the shirt.
But before I place the order, I want to confirm that they'll be here in time for the trade show.
Please call me at 555-0134 and let me know when the shirts would be delivered.
Thanks.
context.transcript_translation:
嗨，我是Alexey Solikov。
我经营一家小公司，有兴趣向贵公司订购一些衬衫。
你看，我的所有员工下个月要去一个贸易展览会，我想让他们穿着绣有我们标志的衬衫。
我看过你们的设计选项，我更喜欢袖子上印有标志的设计。
但在我下单之前，我想确认一下它们是否能在展会前到达。
请给我打电话：555-0134，并告诉我什么时候可以送达衬衫。
